_comment: Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: FUSED.

effects._comment: "they discard a card unless they pay {r}{r}" — the OPPONENT pays or discards, so this is PAY_OR_ELSE against them, not PAY_OR_DAMAGE against us. The previous pay_cost/damage_effect keys were invented and silently ignored.
